title: Pre-Supply Termination Damages Calculation - C&I
content:
*Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts: damages on contracts closed with close reason terminated before flow.*

1. The damages of a termination before supply are its damages kWh multiplied by the structure's liquidated damages rate per kWh, rounded half up to the cent only at that step, but not less than the structure's minimum early termination fee.
2. The damages kWh of a termination before supply are its annual kWh multiplied by its months counted and divided by 12 months per year, rounded half up to a whole kWh, and that figure is billed as the remaining contracted kWh of the line.
3. The annual kWh of a termination before supply are the structure's minimum annual usage, the smallest 12-month historical usage a facility needs for a C&I contract.
4. The months counted for a termination before supply are the contract's term months.

## Worked through (hypothetical figures)

| Item | Case one | Case two |
|---|---|---|
| structure's minimum annual usage | 300001 kWh | 300001 kWh |
| term months | 24 | 12 |
| damages kWh | 300001 multiplied by 24, divided by 12: 600002 | 300001 multiplied by 12, divided by 12: 300001 |
| structure's rate per kWh | $0.0050 | $0.0020 |
| damages before the minimum | 600002 multiplied by 0.0050: $3000.01 | 300001 multiplied by 0.0020: 600.002, rounded to $600.00 |
| structure's minimum fee | $500.00 | $250.00 |
| damages billed | $3000.01 | $600.00 |

## Basis questions

- *Which months count?* The term months shown on the contract.
- *When is the amount rounded?* Once, at the damages, half up to the cent, before the comparison with the minimum fee.
